title: Path length consumed by clause processing
statement: Run the clause-processing operation on a list of literals — each tagged with its position in the clause — and a decision-tree path (a list of variable–direction pairs), starting from restrictions $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$. Writing $\ell$ for the number of literals and $m$ for the length of the path, the residual path returned by the operation has length exactly $m - \min(\ell, m)$; equivalently, this residual length together with $\min(\ell, m)$ sums to $m$.
replaced:
$\mathrm{processClauseLits}$ consumes exactly
$\min(\mathrm{lits.length}, \mathrm{path.length})$ path entries; the remaining
path length plus this minimum equals the original path length.
